label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss): alert-TP - str contains param from request.getHeaderNames(), which is user-controlled header name data. Although encodeForHTML() encodes the output, XSS can still occur via various bypass techniques or if encoding fails. Alert 2 (http-response-splitting): alert-TP - same param flows through list manipulation to str, then to Cookie constructor, then to response.addCookie(). Control characters in header names can cause response splitting at the HTTP protocol level. Both alerts have confirmed attacker-controlled data reaching sinks.
